top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks dip as oil rises; Healey says UK paying ‘Truss penalty’
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM liveblog. Markets are returning from the weekend to weigh up the latest round of rising tensions in the Middle East after the US and Iran have continued to exchange strikes stoking fears of a hit to global oil supply.
